identities.note: No public owners route, entity or page type exists in MC-15; none is created or proposed here.

audienceSemantics.professionals: Professional marine businesses that specify, operate or maintain more than one vessel. Not installers, not individual owners, not a partner programme.
audienceSemantics.installers: Independent installers and technical workshops evaluating installation, commissioning and calibration work. Not a registration, accreditation, directory or agreement.
audienceSemantics.shipowners: The individual owner of a recreational vessel. Commercial shipowners, merchant vessels, professional fleets and the contracted FLEET solution are explicitly excluded.
audienceSemantics.armadorAmbiguity: Spanish 'armador' designates both a recreational-vessel owner and a merchant-vessel owner/operator. This page addresses only the former; the two are never treated as equivalent.
